scope: Bundled v1 only. Question text/choices checked against original PDFs; answer keys checked against official answer PDFs. Existing fixed explanations read for consistency; not IPA official explanations.

ip.method: Visual comparison of scanned question PDF pages 2-10 and the complete answer table. Punctuation and whitespace normalized in the existing transcription.

fe.method: All included question and choice text matched PDF text after NFKC, whitespace and punctuation normalization; checked against the official answer table. Questions 3, 6, 14, 19 with figures/tables excluded.

rights: IPA-public metadata retained; original source attribution and separate learning-explanation attribution displayed. No third-party images bundled. Owner editorial and distribution review remains a release gate.
